root_review: Root逐项读600个现存en、中文义和1200句英文语境，再审三作者全部修改建议；正确基本义和原空保留。作者稿与整批审读冻结后才apply。

root_sources_checked.supports: voltage为电势差，volt=W/A，不是每单位时间的能量。
骨质疏松与骨量、结构改变及多种风险因素有关，不能概称单因缺钙。

changes.before: someone who tells lies
changes.after: A person who tells stories, especially to entertain an audience.
changes.reason: 原义是说谎的人，两句都是给别人讲故事的人；改为对应讲故事这一常用义。

changes.before: fortitude and determination
changes.after: The spine; also, the main support or essential part of an organization or system.
changes.reason: 原义仅为勇气和毅力，与图示脊柱及小企业作为支柱的两句均不对应。

changes.before: A bullfinch.
changes.after: An informal way of saying no.
changes.reason: 原义为灰雀这一旧义，两句均是口语否定回答，不是鸟名。

changes.before: (of the elements) in a wild and stormy manner
changes.after: With great anger, force, or intense effort.
changes.reason: 原义限定自然元素的暴风般运动，两句分别是气愤摇头及拼命打字。

changes.before: a cellular structure that is postulated to exist in order to mediate between a chemical agent that acts on nervous tissue and the physiological response
changes.after: A molecule in or on a cell that binds a particular substance and triggers a response.
changes.reason: 原义将受体称为假定存在且限于神经组织的结构，属于过时限制；细胞受体已有明确分子含义。

changes.before: the rate at which energy is drawn from a source that produces a flow of electricity in a circuit; expressed in volts
changes.after: The difference in electrical potential between two points, measured in volts.
changes.reason: 原义把电压说成能量从电源被取用的速率，混淆功率与电势差；标签和电池读数均指电压。

changes.before: a private place of education for the young
changes.after: A school or college that trains people for religious ministry.
changes.reason: 原义为青少年的私立学校这一旧用法，当前中文与两句指神学院。

changes.before: live a life of pleasure, especially with respect to alcoholic consumption
changes.after: To gradually disappear or spread out until no longer concentrated.
changes.reason: 原义是沉溺享乐、尤其饮酒，两句指雾气及怒气渐渐消散。

changes.before: n a specialist in the care of babies
changes.after: A doctor who specializes in the health and illnesses of children.
changes.reason: 原义只写照护婴儿的专家，既未指明医生，也把儿科的对象错误限定为婴儿。

changes.before: designed to incite to indecency or lust
changes.after: Sexually offensive or indecent; also, shockingly excessive.
changes.reason: 原义将有意引发淫欲当成必要条件，不能准确解释粗俗语言；巨额开支例句另为令人愤慨的夸张义。

changes.before: n a religious doctrine that is proclaimed as true without proof
changes.after: A principle or belief forming part of a philosophy, religion, or system of ideas.
changes.reason: 原义限定未经证明便宣称为真的宗教教义，不能解释诚实这一处世原则，并加入不必要的评价。

changes.before: a noncommittal or equivocal position
changes.after: To sit with a leg on each side of something, or extend across both sides of a boundary.
changes.reason: 原义是含糊不表态的立场；两句是跨坐自行车和横跨行政边界。

changes.before: of or relating to lines of longitude
changes.after: Running along the length of something; in research, following subjects over a period of time.
changes.reason: 原义只指经线，而两句及中文指沿长度方向的裂缝与长期追踪研究。

changes.before: relatively permanent disorder of the mind
changes.after: Extreme foolishness; also, a legal or older term for severe mental illness.
changes.reason: 原义把精神失常断言为相对永久的病状，既过强也未标明旧称；两句分别是夸张批评和法律术语。

changes.before: an unsophisticated country person
changes.after: Having a simple style typical of the countryside.
changes.reason: 原义为不谙世故的乡下人，当前两句均以形容词描述木屋及咖啡馆乡村风格。

changes.before: n something hard to endure
changes.after: Thoroughness, precision, and strict standards in work or thought.
changes.reason: 原义是难以忍受的事物，与实验和思考的严谨用法不对应。

changes.before: the rate of flow of energy or particles across a given surface
changes.after: A state of continuous change or movement.
changes.reason: 原义取物理学穿过表面的能量或粒子流率，中文及例句是计划不断变化或助焊剂；选前者的正确基本义。

changes.before: a highball with liquor and water with sugar and lemon or lime juice
changes.after: A strap or piece of cloth used to support an injured arm; also, to throw something casually.
changes.reason: 原义取一种混合酒，与支撑手臂的吊带及把包扔上后座两句均无关。

changes.before: Alt. of Amid
changes.after: In the middle of, or surrounded by, something.
changes.reason: 原内容只是另一词形的交叉引用，未解释含义；两句是混乱之中及树木环绕。

changes.before: (law) the act of condemning (as land forfeited for public use) or judging to be unfit for use (as a food product or an unsafe building)
changes.after: A strong expression of disapproval, especially of something considered wrong.
changes.reason: 原义取征用土地或判定建筑不适用的法律义，两句均指对决定或暴力的谴责。

changes.before: extinct East Germanic language of the ancient Goths; the only surviving record being fragments of a 4th-century translation of the Bible by Bishop Ulfilas
changes.after: Relating to medieval pointed-arch architecture, or fiction with dark, mysterious settings.
changes.reason: 原义为古代哥特人的语言，当前中文和两句指建筑风格与小说类型。

changes.before: someone who is unsuccessful
changes.after: Something that fails badly; also, to fall or sit down heavily and loosely.
changes.reason: 原义只指不成功的人，两句分别是失败的电影与一头倒在沙发上的动作。

changes.before: unrestrained merrymaking
changes.after: To enjoy something greatly, often expressed with in.
changes.reason: 原义只取狂欢名词，两句均为revel in动词，且第一句是享受安静而非喧闹狂欢。

changes.before: receptacle that holds odds and ends (as sewing materials)
changes.after: Neat and well arranged; also, to put things in order.
changes.reason: 原义取装零碎物品的容器，两句是整洁的桌面和收拾厨房。

changes.before: s dissenting (especially dissenting with the majority opinion)
changes.after: Causing disagreement or hostility between people.
changes.reason: 原义是持异议、尤其反对多数人的意见，与提议或话题引起分裂的因果方向不同。

changes.before: sound recording on a narrow strip of a motion picture film
changes.after: The music and other recorded sound accompanying a film or television program.
changes.reason: 原义仅为胶片窄条上的声音录制，无法说明当前作为原声专辑及场景配乐的现代常用义。

changes.before: not returned in kind
changes.after: Not answered or given a reply.
changes.reason: 原义是没有得到同样方式的回报，与消息无人回复和问题未解答不对应。

changes.before: n a platform raised above the surrounding level to give prominence to the person on it
changes.after: A raised stand in a church from which a minister speaks to the congregation.
changes.reason: 原义只是任何突出讲者的高台，未包含讲道台的教堂及宗教用途，容易与舞台混淆。

changes.before: obscene words for unacceptable behavior
changes.after: Nonsense or dishonest talk; also, to deceive someone with such talk, in vulgar language.
changes.reason: 原义只说用于不可接受行为的脏话，没有定义胡扯或骗人的谈话；两句分别为借口和欺骗性说法。

changes.before: a formal reception of visitors or guests (as at a royal court)
changes.after: A raised bank or wall beside a river that helps prevent flooding.
changes.reason: 原义取王室等场合的正式接待仪式，两句均指河边防洪堤。

changes.before: urinate, of cattle and horses
changes.after: No longer fresh; also, dull or unoriginal through being repeated too often.
changes.reason: 原义取牛马排尿这一罕用动词，两句为不新鲜的面包及陈旧的想法。

changes.before: a philosopher who believes that universals are real and exist independently of anyone thinking of them
changes.after: A person who faces situations practically, or an artist who depicts everyday life as it is.
changes.reason: 原义是相信共相独立存在的哲学派别，两句为务实的人及描绘日常生活的写实画家。

changes.before: an easy victory
changes.after: A person who has left home without permission; also, extremely successful or out of control.
changes.reason: 原义仅指轻易获胜，与离家出走的人及runaway success的修饰用法不对应。

changes.before: a diplomat having less authority than an ambassador
changes.after: A representative sent by a government or organization to carry out a special mission.
changes.reason: 原义限定权力比大使小的外交人员，不能概括当代special envoy，也不必一律按使节等级理解。

changes.before: a shoot arising from a plant's roots
changes.after: A person who is easily deceived, or someone strongly attracted to a particular thing, informally.
changes.reason: 原义为植物根部长出的萌蘖，两句都是口语中容易受骗或对某物着迷的人。

changes.before: informal terms for a human `tooth'
changes.after: An informal word for a helicopter; also, a tool or machine used to cut things into pieces.
changes.reason: 原义取人的牙齿这一口语义，两句为救援直升机和切洋葱的切碎器。

changes.before: (orthopedics) the act of pulling on a bone or limb (as in a fracture) to relieve pressure or align parts in a special way during healing
changes.after: The grip between a surface and moving wheels or feet; also support or progress for an idea or plan.
changes.reason: 旧义为骨科牵引，两句及当前中文为抓地力和获得支持，现题面错配。

changes.before: relatively small placental mammals having a single pair of constantly growing incisor teeth specialized for gnawing
changes.after: A mammal with one pair of continuously growing front teeth in each jaw, adapted for gnawing.
changes.reason: 旧定义只写一对门齿而未区分上下颌；机构资料确认上下颌各一对，避免教成总共一对。

changes.before: a fabric interwoven with threads of metal
changes.after: Unable to walk normally because of a weak or injured leg; also weak or unconvincing.
changes.reason: 旧义为金属丝织物lamé，与蹩脚借口和跛马两句不符。

changes.before: n something having the property of being analogous to something else
changes.after: Using continuously varying physical signals, or showing measurements with hands or a pointer on a dial.
changes.reason: 旧义为相似对应物这一名词，未说明模拟记录或指针时钟的技术含义。

changes.before: characterized by errors; not agreeing with a model or not following established rules; the wrong side of the road"
changes.after: Containing errors or defects; not working correctly.
changes.reason: 旧定义混入the wrong side of the road和残留引号，且未清楚表达充电器有故障；删除串入的无关文本。

changes.before: any plant disease characterized by drooping and shriveling; usually caused by parasites attacking the roots
changes.after: To droop or lose firmness, especially through heat or lack of water; also to lose energy.
changes.reason: 旧义为通常由寄生物致根部病害的植物疾病，不适合受热花朵蔫或人精神萎靡；不把普通萎蔫等同疾病。

changes.before: Of thee, or belonging to thee; the more common form of
changes.after: An old-fashioned possessive form meaning 'your', used when addressing one person.
changes.reason: 旧定义截断在the more common form of，改为完整古体物主形式说明；不猜丢失的后文。

changes.before: a drug made from part of a plant (as the bark or root or leaves)
changes.after: Relating to plants or the scientific study of plants.
changes.reason: 旧义为植物制药物这一名词，两句均是植物或植物学相关的形容词。

changes.before: a member of an uncivilized people
changes.after: Fierce, violent or extremely harsh.
changes.reason: 旧义为所谓未开化民族成员的冒犯称呼，两句均形容猛烈抨击或风暴，不能把旧人群称呼当本题定义。

changes.before: the heading or position of a vessel relative to the trim of its sails
changes.after: A small short nail; to fasten something with one; also a way of approaching a problem.
changes.reason: 旧义为船只相对风帆的航向，两句均非航海语境，分别钉通知和改变策略。

changes.before: v designate by an identifying term
changes.after: The way something is designed or arranged to achieve a particular appearance.
changes.reason: 旧义为以某个称谓称呼的动词，两句为汽车造型和发型打理这一名词。

changes.before: someone entrusted to hold the stakes for two or more persons betting against one another; must deliver the stakes to the winner
changes.after: A person or organization with an interest in, or affected by, an activity or decision.
changes.reason: 旧义只指保管赌资的人，当前两句为项目利益相关方。

changes.before: measured by an angle or by the rate of change of an angle
changes.after: Relating to angles, or having sharp corners or a thin, bony outline.
changes.reason: 旧义专指以角度或角度变化率计量的技术量；两句形容设计和脸部棱角，改为当前形状义并保留角相关含义。

changes.before: (politics) granting favors or giving contracts or making appointments to office in return for political support
changes.after: The business customers give a shop or service, or support given by a sponsor.
changes.reason: 旧义为交换政治支持的职位或利益分配，两句均为普通光顾或捐赠赞助，不需要政治交换。

changes.before: an atoll in the Marshall Islands; formerly used by the United States as a site for testing nuclear weapons
changes.after: A two-piece swimsuit.
changes.reason: 旧义为马绍尔群岛的核试验岛礁，两句均为泳装。

changes.before: Mexican revolutionary leader (1877-1923)
changes.after: A large or comfortable house, often used for holidays.
changes.reason: 旧义为墨西哥革命领袖，两句均是租住的别墅。

changes.before: add herbs or spices to
changes.after: The thin outer peel of a citrus fruit, used for flavoring; also lively enthusiasm and enjoyment.
changes.reason: 旧义为添加香料这一动词，两句为柠檬外皮或生活热情。

changes.before: descriptive of any event or stimulus or process that has an effect on events or stimuli or processes that occur subsequently
changes.after: Taking the initiative to prevent problems or create opportunities, rather than simply reacting to events.
changes.reason: 旧义是前一事件影响后续事件的心理学技术含义，不能准确说明两句主动解决问题的行为。

changes.before: a cavalry unit consisting of two or more troops and headquarters and supporting arms
changes.after: A military unit of aircraft and their crews, or a group of warships.
changes.reason: 旧义为骑兵中队，当前中文和两句均为飞行中队；不把骑兵单位当航空定义。

changes.before: an arrangement of branching parts
changes.after: A consequence of an action or decision, often complicated or unexpected.
changes.reason: 旧义为分枝结构，两句均是行动或决定的后果。

changes.before: the act of groping; and instance of groping
changes.after: To search by feeling with your hands, especially in the dark; also to struggle to find words or ideas.
changes.reason: 旧定义用groping循环解释且有and instance笔误，不能提供可理解的辨义信息；两句为摸开关和搜寻词句。

changes.before: a minute life form (especially a disease-causing bacterium); the term is not in technical use
changes.after: A microscopic life form or biological agent, such as a bacterium, fungus or virus.
changes.reason: 旧句称该词不用于技术语境，但CDC专业资料明确使用并定义该术语；删除错误使用限制。

changes.before: completely clear and fine
changes.after: Calm, peaceful and untroubled.
changes.reason: 旧义为天气完全晴朗，两句为平静湖面或沉着的人，当前中文未教天气晴朗义。

changes.before: the failure to develop some part or organ
changes.after: The act of stopping, restraining or reducing an activity, expression or unwanted effect.
changes.reason: 旧义为某器官未发育，两句均为压制异议或抑制噪声。

changes.before: English lexicographer who wrote a well-known book on English usage (1858-1933)
changes.reason: 旧义为特定男性词典编纂者Henry Watson Fowler，当前两句只是普通姓氏Fowler；清空英文题，不凭姓氏推断具体历史人物，也不添加泛用姓名多解题。

changes.before: an elementary particle with 0 charge and mass about equal to a proton; enters into the structure of the atomic nucleus
changes.after: An electrically neutral particle found in atomic nuclei, with a mass close to that of a proton.
changes.reason: 旧定义称其为elementary particle；CERN确认其为夸克组成的复合粒子，删除错误基本粒子分类，保留电中性与核组成信息。

changes.before: relatively slow in mental or emotional or physical development
changes.after: Slowed or delayed; the former use for a person with an intellectual disability is offensive.
changes.reason: 旧定义不标语域地描述人群发展缓慢，与化学反应减慢和旧称冒犯的现有教学语境不符。

changes.before: v secure the assistance of by granting a subsidy, as of nations or military forces
changes.after: To help pay the cost of an activity, service or product.
changes.reason: 旧定义把资助写成换取协助，公交补贴与学生出行资助不要求接受者提供政治或军事帮助。

changes.before: slang terms for inside information
changes.after: An informal word for drugs; as a slang adjective, very good or impressive.
changes.reason: 旧义为内幕消息，两句及中文为毒品或很酷的；不将毒品定义限为某一物质或特定法律状态。

changes.before: French educator who lost his sight at the age of three and who invented a system of writing and printing for sightless people (1809-1852)
changes.after: A writing system using raised dot patterns that can be read by touch.
changes.reason: 旧义为发明者Louis Braille这一人名，两句均为可触读的文字系统。

changes.before: abnormal loss of bony tissue resulting in fragile porous bones attributable to a lack of calcium; most common in postmenopausal women
changes.after: A condition in which bones lose density and strength, making them more likely to break.
changes.reason: 旧定义把骨质疏松归因于缺钙，过于单一；NHS列骨重建失衡及多种风险因素，改为疾病特征，不提供诊疗建议。

changes.before: a remedy for hearing loss or deafness
changes.after: Relating to sound; for musical instruments, producing sound naturally rather than electronically.
changes.reason: 旧义为治疗听力损失的药物，两句均为原声乐器或声学设计。

changes.before: a person who has obsessions
changes.after: Thinking about or doing something to an excessive degree, with difficulty stopping.
changes.reason: 旧定义是有强迫执念的人这一名词，两句形容过度关注细节或整洁的行为，不应以人物名词定义代替性质。

changes.before: association of ex-servicemen
changes.after: A large military unit, especially in ancient Rome; also, very numerous.
changes.reason: 旧义为退伍军人协会，第一例古罗马军团并非退役团体，第二例为众多的形容词。

changes.before: a member of a sect
changes.after: Relating to a religious or political faction, especially showing prejudice against other groups.
changes.reason: 旧定义只指教派成员，两句均为宗派相关冲突或分歧这一形容词，当前中文不教成员名词义。

changes.before: caramelized sugar cooled in thin sheets
changes.after: Easily broken or cracked rather than bent.
changes.reason: 旧义为薄糖片，两句形容塑料或饼干容易碎。

changes.before: a sudden short attack
changes.after: A brief visit or attempt at a new activity; also a short, sudden raid.
changes.reason: 旧义只有短暂袭击，两句并非袭击，分别是尝试爵士乐和逛市场；保留合法袭击义但说明当前用法。

changes.before: lacking definite form or limits
changes.after: covered with clouds, or not clear because of suspended particles
changes.reason: 原en是不明确边界的意思，两句是多云天气和浑浊水。

changes.before: any of numerous sun-loving low-growing evergreens of the genus Armeria having round heads of pink or white flowers
changes.after: careful use of money and resources to avoid waste
changes.reason: 原en为海石竹属植物，与节俭及二手商店两句错配。

changes.before: British statesman famous for his oratory; pleaded the cause of the American colonists in British Parliament and defended the parliamentary system (1729-1797)
changes.reason: 旧en特指Edmund Burke，但两句是未确定身份的普通姓氏人物，不假定他们是历史人物。

changes.before: a unit of mass equal to the mass that accelerates at 1 foot/sec/sec when acted upon by a force of 1 pound; approximately 14.5939 kilograms
changes.after: a soft-bodied animal resembling a snail without a visible shell, or a large swallow of a drink
changes.reason: 原en是英制质量单位，与蛞蝓及一大口饮料均错配。

changes.before: r in an intelligible manner
changes.after: in a way that is reasonable or easy to sympathize with
changes.reason: 原en是表达清楚可懂，实际两句是疲累/难过可以理解的评价。

changes.before: someone (especially a woman) who annoys people by constantly finding fault
changes.after: to speak angrily to someone because of their behavior
changes.reason: 原en为爱挑错的人且特别限定女性，两句为责骂动作。

changes.before: properties acquired during a person's formative years
changes.after: the way a child is raised and cared for, especially within a family
changes.reason: 原en是成长时期获得的特性，upbringing实际指抚养教养方式及成长经历。

changes.before: impatience with annoyances
changes.after: unwillingness to accept others, or an inability to tolerate a food or substance
changes.reason: 原en只讲对烦恼不耐烦，与宗教不宽容及乳糖不耐受两个实际义不对应。

changes.before: someone who plays golf poorly
changes.after: a person skilled in computers who may gain access to systems, with or without permission
changes.reason: 原en为差劲高尔夫球手，两句均为计算机技术及安全语境。

changes.before: a distinctive influence
changes.after: a mark made by pressing or printing something, or to make such a mark
changes.reason: 原en仅独特影响，两句为鞋印和印标志的具体动作。

changes.before: Indian nun and missionary in the Roman Catholic Church (born of Albanian parents in what is now Macedonia); dedicated to helping the poor in India (1910-1997)
changes.reason: 旧en特指Mother Teresa；两句只识别女性名，不能把未确定身份者讲成该历史人物。

changes.before: Asian tree having clusters of usually white blossoms and edible fruit resembling the peach
